import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Pb {
	
	public static void main(String[] args) throws NumberFormatException, IOException {
		
		Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
		BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		ArrayList<String> arr = new ArrayList<>();
		ArrayList<Integer> ar = new ArrayList<>();
		int tam = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
		String cad = br.readLine();
		String word = "";
		
		int cont = 0, mayor = 0;
		boolean flg = false;
		
		for (int i = 0; i < tam; i++) {
			if (cad.charAt(i) == '(') {
				if (cont >= mayor) {
					mayor = cont;
					cont = 0;
				}
				cont = 0;
				flg = true;
				continue;
			}
			if (cad.charAt(i) == ')') {
				flg = false;
				if (!word.isEmpty()) {
					arr.add(word);
					word = "";
				}
				continue;
			} else if (flg && cad.charAt(i) != '_') {
				word += cad.charAt(i);
				continue;
			}
			else if (flg && cad.charAt(i) == '_' && !word.isEmpty()) {
				arr.add(word);
				word = "";
				continue;
			}
			else if (flg == false && cad.charAt(i) != '_') {
				cont++;
				if (i == tam - 1 && cont >= mayor) {
					mayor = cont;
				}
				continue;
			}
			else if (flg == false && cad.charAt(i) == '_') {
				if (cont >= mayor) {
					mayor = cont;
					cont = 0;
				}
				cont = 0;
			}
		}
		System.out.println(mayor + " " + arr.size());
	}

}
